en: Look! A little cicak on the wall. Hello, cicak!
Cicak goes up, up, up. Tap, tap, tap.
Cicak goes down, down, down. Tap, tap.
Cicak sees the bright lamp. Cek, cek, cek!
Sleepy cicak hides behind the picture frame. Night, night, cicak.
id: Lihat! Ada cicak kecil di dinding. Halo, cicak!
Cicak naik, naik, naik. Tap, tap, tap.
Cicak turun, turun, turun. Tap, tap.
Cicak melihat lampu yang terang. Cek, cek, cek!
Cicak mengantuk bersembunyi di balik bingkai foto. Selamat tidur, cicak.

readAloudNotes.en: Point to a wall and wave hello.
Walk two fingers slowly up your child's arm on each 'up'.
readAloudNotes.id: Jalankan dua jari pelan-pelan naik di lengan anak setiap kata 'naik'.

readAloudNotes.en: Walk your fingers back down to the hand.
readAloudNotes.id: Jalankan jari turun lagi ke tangan.

readAloudNotes.en: Say 'cek, cek, cek' in a small voice and invite your child to copy.
readAloudNotes.id: Ucapkan 'cek, cek, cek' dengan suara kecil dan ajak anak menirukan.

readAloudNotes.en: Cover your eyes with your hands to 'hide', then whisper goodnight.
readAloudNotes.id: Tutup mata dengan tangan seperti bersembunyi, lalu bisikkan selamat tidur.

sequenceCards.en: Card 1: a small cicak on a pale wall
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 1: cicak kecil di dinding berwarna terang

sequenceCards.en: Card 2: the cicak near the ceiling with an arrow pointing up
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 2: cicak dekat langit-langit dengan panah ke atas

sequenceCards.en: Card 3: the cicak low on the wall with an arrow pointing down
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 3: cicak di bagian bawah dinding dengan panah ke bawah

sequenceCards.en: Card 4: the cicak peeping out from behind a picture frame
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 4: cicak mengintip dari balik bingkai foto

objectives.en: Listens to a short story and joins in with up and down movements.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita pendek dan ikut bergerak naik dan turun.

objectives.en: Understands the position words up and down.
objectives.id: Memahami kata posisi naik dan turun.

meaning.en: go where others cannot see you
meaning.id: pergi ke tempat yang tidak terlihat

prompt.en: Where did the cicak go at the end?
prompt.id: Ke mana cicak pergi di akhir cerita?

prompt.en: Why did we say 'night, night' at the end?
prompt.id: Mengapa kita bilang 'selamat tidur' di akhir?

en: because the cicak was going to rest

connection.en: A cicak (house gecko) can walk up a wall because of special pads on its toes.
connection.id: Cicak bisa berjalan di dinding karena jari kakinya punya bantalan khusus.

discussionPrompts.en: Can you make your fingers climb up like a cicak?
discussionPrompts.id: Bisakah jarimu memanjat naik seperti cicak?

discussionPrompts.en: Where do you think the cicak sleeps in our house?
discussionPrompts.id: Menurutmu, di mana cicak tidur di rumah kita?

offlineActivity.en: At dusk, look together for a cicak near a lamp. Say 'up' or 'down' each time it moves. Just watch it; do not try to catch it.
offlineActivity.id: Saat senja, cari cicak di dekat lampu bersama-sama. Ucapkan 'naik' atau 'turun' setiap kali ia bergerak. Cukup dilihat; jangan mencoba menangkapnya.

factChecks.claim: House geckos can climb walls because of special pads on their toes.

safetyNotes.en: Watch geckos without catching them, and wash hands if your child touches places where they have left droppings.
safetyNotes.id: Amati cicak tanpa menangkapnya, dan cuci tangan anak jika ia menyentuh tempat yang terkena kotoran cicak.
